title: Community Trigon Runs
description: Completed or release-ready Trigon Challenges submitted by people outside the core UBT/Luna•Prime R&D lane. Community authorship, historical identifiers, consent, provenance, uncertainty, and claim ceilings are preserved per run.
public_id_rule: Assign public release IDs sequentially as TRIGON-COMMUNITY-NNNN. Historical submission labels remain in each record and are never rewritten.
separation_rule: Community runs must remain visibly separate from UBT/Luna•Prime project-originated R&D runs so outside contributions are not presented as internal research and internal experiments are not presented as independent submissions.

runs.title: Interpretive Risk Protocol (IRP) minimal-baseline Trigon run
